intro.h2: A master bath done right, often in days
paragraphs: Integral Renovations handles bathroom remodeling in Buford, GA from its shop on Braselton Highway, and master baths are among the projects its Google reviewers mention most. Reviewers say owner Taylor Scalera visits often to check on progress, and they name his crew members, like Carlos and Juan, in their reviews.

The work starts with a free design consultation about your goals and budget. From there the team can build a 3D rendering so you can walk through the room before anything is torn out. Depending on scope, many of its bathroom remodels are finished in just a few days, so you are not without a bathroom for long.

services.h2: Remodeling services from the Buford shop

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Full renovations, master baths and small-bathroom remodels that make the most of tight space. The team installs custom showers and tubs, vanities and countertops, storage and tile, with project managers keeping each job on track and within budget.

image.alt: Freestanding soaking tub under a picture window framed by dark marble-look wall tile

items.name: Showers, Tile & Flooring
items.blurb: Walk-in showers with frameless glass, multi-jet systems and tiled niches, plus tile and flooring for bathrooms, kitchens and the rest of the house. Reviewers mention new floors finished on tight timelines, with the old flooring ripped out and replaced fast.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with marble-look tile, frameless glass enclosure and rain showerhead beside a window

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling & Installation
items.blurb: Complete kitchen remodels or targeted upgrades: custom cabinetry or cabinet refacing, quartz, granite, marble or butcher block counters, new backsplash tile, lighting, flooring and appliance integration. The crew handles the plumbing, electrical and cabinet installation too.

image.alt: White kitchen with wood-stained island, stainless gas cooktop, glass pendant lights and built-in shelving

items.name: Basement Remodels
items.blurb: Unfinished basements turned into living space, game rooms and bars. Basement renovation is one of the topics Google reviewers mention most, and one finished basement even includes a golf simulator room with turf, an impact screen and a wall-mounted TV.

image.alt: Finished basement golf simulator room with green turf, impact screen and wall-mounted TV

items.name: Complete Home Remodels
items.blurb: Whole-house updates, from opening up a floor plan to adding an extra bedroom for a growing family. Designers, contractors and project managers work as one team, and the company also builds decks and screened porches when the project heads outdoors.

image.alt: Two-story living room with built-in shelving, fireplace, ceiling fan and hardwood floors after a home remodel

items.title: An owner who started as an estimator
items.text: Taylor Scalera learned pricing as a project estimator before running a growing remodeling company. He founded Integral to give homeowners quality work with extremely fair pricing.

items.title: You know when the crew is coming
items.text: Reviewer Shari H. wrote that Integral kept her informed and updated on progress each day, with arrival times given every morning.

items.title: Quick bathroom turnarounds
items.text: Depending on scope, many Integral bathroom remodels are finished in just a few days. Albert F. wrote that his bathroom and new kitchen backsplash were done on time and on budget.

items.title: See it in 3D first
items.text: Integral offers 3D renderings with layouts, colors and finishes you can adjust, so you can walk through the new bathroom or kitchen before demolition and avoid surprises.

about.h2: Taylor Scalera built Integral after years in the field
about.text: Taylor Scalera spent his summers learning the details of residential construction. After a short corporate job out of college, he went back to building, starting as a project estimator for a small handyman business and rising to vice president as it grew to a national presence. After six years there, he founded Integral Renovations. In his words, his goal is to use his knowledge and network to give homeowners a quality, hassle-free experience with extremely fair pricing. Today he leads a team with backgrounds in design, construction and project management, and reviewers say he visits often to check on progress.

image.alt: Taylor Scalera, founder of Integral Renovations

process.h2: Bathroom Remodeling in Buford, GA, Step by Step

steps.title: Free design consultation
steps.text: Sit down with the team to talk through your vision, preferences and budget, and share the bathroom ideas you have been saving.

steps.title: Design and planning
steps.text: Integral builds a custom design plan and helps you choose materials, fixtures and layout. A 3D rendering is available so you can see the room first.

steps.title: Construction and installation
steps.text: The crew handles everything from demolition to installing vanities, showers and flooring, with a project manager keeping the job on schedule and within budget.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: When the work is done, the team walks the new bathroom with you to make sure every detail meets your expectations before they call it finished.

service_area.h2: Based in Buford, working across the Atlanta area
service_area.text: Integral Renovations works out of 2693 Braselton Hwy in Buford, Georgia, and takes on projects for clients across Georgia, including Atlanta and the surrounding areas. The office is open weekdays from 10 am to 4 pm, with evening and Saturday visits available on request. If you are not sure whether your home is in range, call the shop and ask.

faq.h2: Bathroom remodeling questions from Buford homeowners

items.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
items.a: It depends on scope, but many Integral bathroom remodels are completed in just a few days, so you get your bathroom back without a long disruption. Larger master bath renovations take longer, so ask for a timeline for your exact scope at the free design consultation.

items.q: Is the design consultation really free?
items.a: Yes. Integral starts every bathroom and kitchen project with a free consultation to talk through your vision, your preferences and your budget. It is also the time to share any bathroom ideas you have saved, so the team can tell you what will work in your space.

items.q: Can I see my new bathroom before work starts?
items.a: Yes. Integral offers 3D renderings that let you walk through the planned room and adjust layouts, colors and finishes in real time. Seeing the space first helps you make decisions with confidence and cuts down on surprises once construction begins.

Yes. Kitchen work ranges from complete remodels to targeted upgrades: custom cabinetry or cabinet refacing, countertops in quartz, granite, marble or butcher block, backsplash tile, lighting, flooring and appliance integration. The crew handles the plumbing, electrical and cabinet installation as part of the job.

items.q: What hours can I reach you?
items.a: The office is open Monday through Friday from 10 am to 4 pm. After 4 pm and on Saturdays, appointments are available on request. Call (470) 993-4343 or email taylor@integralrenovations.co, and you can also request a quote through the online form.

final_cta.h2: Talk to Taylor about your bathroom
final_cta.text: Book a free design consultation and see what your new bathroom could look like.

Home H1 is a generic 'HOME REMODELING SERVICES IN BUFORD, GA'; bathrooms, the most-reviewed work, are not featured above the fold.
The testimonial widget truncates every review mid-sentence ('Read more'), and its newest review is from August 2025 while Google has reviews from two months ago.

Home and bathroom page copy leans on stock filler phrases instead of the firm's own facts.
FAQ answers on timelines, estimates and service area are collapsed; no town list beyond Buford and 'Atlanta and surrounding areas'.
